She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.

sky cinema family.title: Hook
sky cinema family.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

sky cinema family.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
sky cinema family.desc: Heartwarming tale in which a ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema comedy.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema comedy.title: Superbad
sky cinema comedy.desc: Two inseparable best friends navigate the last weeks of high school and are invited to a gigantic house party. Together with their nerdy friend, they spend a long day trying to score enough alcohol to supply the party and inebriate two girls in order to kick-start their sex lives before they go off to college. Their quest is complicated after one of them falls in with two inept cops who are determined to show him a good time.

sky cinema comedy.title: The World's End
sky cinema comedy.desc: An immature 40-year-old convinces his childhood pals to join him in an epic pub-crawl, but as they make their way toward their final destination, a battle for mankind emerges.

sky cinema comedy.title: The Naked Gun
sky cinema comedy.desc: Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down.

sky cinema comedy.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
sky cinema comedy.desc: Tale about an unconventional sleuth's attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

sky cinema comedy.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
sky cinema comedy.desc: Sequel about the zany private detective who specialises in locating missing pets. Ace Ventura travels to Africa to search for a kidnapped sacred albino bat, which reputedly has the power to restore peace between two warring tribes.

sky cinema comedy.title: Hitch
sky cinema comedy.desc: Albert is neither the most attractive nor the most confident man in the world, so when he falls in love with one of his firm's clients, Allegra Cole, he calls in an expert to help him win her over. Hitch is the business name of Alex Hitchins, and he earns his pay by teaching men how to woo the girl of their choice.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Captain Picard and his crew are sent to the planet Romulus, where a new leader, Shinzon, wishes to make peace with the Federation. Upon arriving at the planet, Picard discovers Shinzon's plan is to destroy the Enterprise with his powerful craft the Scimitar and then advance on a defenceless Earth. Picard must use all his cunning to outwit his adversary but faces an obstacle: Shizon is a younger clone of himself.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Katniss Everdeen finds herself in District 13 after she destroys the Games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to launch an assassination attempt on President Snow.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema thriller.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema thriller.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bourne Identity
sky cinema thriller.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bourne Supremacy
sky cinema thriller.desc: Life never becomes easy for ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, who is forced out of hiding, and must return to Europe to find out exactly what happened in his past. It's not easy, as he's being framed for murder and his old employers are leading the manhunt.

sky cinema thriller.title: Civil War
sky cinema thriller.desc: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Equalizer
sky cinema thriller.desc: A former commando who had faked his own death comes out of retirement to rescue a young girl from violent Russian mobsters.

sky cinema greats.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
sky cinema greats.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

sky cinema greats.title: Arthur
sky cinema greats.desc: An alcoholic millionaire is threatened with losing his inheritance if he does not marry the girl of his parents' choosing. Despite his dislike for his prospective bride, he bows to the inevitable only to meet a light-fingered waitress who steals his heart. John Gielgud won an Oscar for his role as Arthur's loyal but outspoken valet.

sky cinema greats.title: Big Daddy
sky cinema greats.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

sky cinema greats.title: The Wedding Singer
sky cinema greats.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).

sky cinema greats.title: Caddyshack
sky cinema greats.desc: A rich property developer wants to take over an exclusive country club and so challenges its pompous president to a game of golf leading to utter mayhem, and a stream of surreal and crude visual gags.

sky cinema greats.title: The Man With Two Brains
sky cinema greats.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

sky cinema greats.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
sky cinema greats.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.

sky cinema drama.title: The Shawshank Redemption
sky cinema drama.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd `Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.

sky cinema drama.title: Cast Away
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a man's bid for survival on a desert island following a plane crash. An employee of Fedex snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.

sky cinema drama.title: The Choral
sky cinema drama.desc: As World War I rages on, Dr. Henry Guthrie takes over a British choral society that's lost most of its men to the army. The community soon discovers that the best response to the chaos of war is to make beautiful music together.

sky cinema drama.title: Legends of the Fall
sky cinema drama.desc: Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

sky cinema drama.title: Dreamgirls
sky cinema drama.desc: Following the adventures of The Dreamettes, an all-girl singing group. They're going nowhere fast until they meet fast-talking car salesman-come-manager who has ambitions to make a fortune selling black music to a white audience. He persuades them to become backing singers for James `Thunder' Early, but the larger-than-life lead singer Effie White must step out of the spotlight in favour of the more image-friendly Deena Jones.

sky cinema drama.title: Regretting You
sky cinema drama.desc: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.
